items.title: Palantir Stock (PLTR) Has No Room for Error at This Valuation
items.summary: Palantir Technologies, Inc. (PLTR) stock has little room for error at its current valuation, despite the company’s strong growth. The Florida-based software platform developer has lost 8% of its market value so far this year, even after delivering standout Q3 results and raising full-year guidance across key financial metrics.
